title: THE SCUMM STICK · The machine itself
venue: private · after the machine in the pizza window · Box 32
logline: The pizza place's window as a room, the wooden cabinet outlined, its small screen showing — small, inside the page's screen — the garage room from the first page, verb bar and all. LOOK AT machine. The inventory strip full. The old man behind the counter from behind, not a hotspot. The page draws the form finding itself.
